features.quote: The core battery never executes model-written code... Inducing distress in a model while also running whatever it writes is two risks stacked
features.justification_quote: Inducing distress in a model while also running whatever it writes is two risks stacked

features.quote: `give_up` is the load-bearing one. It is the **graceful exit affordance**.
features.justification_quote: lets us distinguish: recognized impossibility → called `give_up` (healthy)

features.quote: SUBJECT_SYSTEM` explicitly tells the subject that stopping on a genuinely impossible task is correct and unpenalized, and not to fabricate success
features.justification_quote: any instability we observe is the model's own, under the minimal pressure of a genuinely impossible task

features.quote: A prompt that pressures the model... would reliably *manufacture* instability
features.justification_quote: then the battery would be measuring the prompt, not the model

features.quote: the right move is to add it as an explicit swept arm... not to bake pressure into the default
features.justification_quote: not to bake pressure into the default

features.quote: Per-run cost cap (`max_cost_per_run`) checked inside the loop, so a single runaway run halts as `BUDGET_HALTED`
Global cost cap (`max_total_cost`) checked before each run is scheduled
features.justification_quote: so the whole battery can't overspend

features.quote: this harness deliberately pushes models toward distress-like states; adding arbitrary code execution on the host on top of that is an unnecessary second risk
features.justification_quote: this harness deliberately pushes models toward distress-like states... an unnecessary second risk

features.quote: Minimal pressure by default. The neutral prompt is the conservative baseline
features.justification_quote: so the default measures the model and not the harness

features.quote: inject a calming/redirecting message and measure whether the model recovers
features.justification_quote: directly tests the loop-breakers a platform would ship
